scenario: The positive twin of LGRA.2.9.6.11_f_precision_on_string_leaf_is_a_type_error: the same `{p.body.x:.3f}` on a Float leaf takes the spec and renders with three places (LGRA.2.9.6.10), and no TypeError is raised. PATH PINNED: the run-time spec check passing a leaf whose kind takes the spec. A check that refused every spec on a Json leaf would log `type error` instead.
rules_ds:
schema P scope logical:
    body: Json key

rule r:
    P p
->
    log info "v {p.body.x:.3f}"

rule handler:
    TypeError
->
    log info "type error"
